create_solvent_from_atoms: create a Solvent object by passing an ase.Atoms object representing a solvent molecule
create_solvent_from_db: create a Solvent object by passing a solvent index to load from the default solvent database
get_molecules_per_volume: get the number of solvent molecules per angstrom cubed using the molecules_per_volume property
override_solvent_density: create a Solvent object with a custom density value instead of the database default
get_solvent_molar_mass: get the molar mass of a Solvent object by summing atomic masses via the molar_mass attribute
